steps.what: opener, credibility, asks for a call

variants.body:
Hi {FIRST_NAME},

Hope you're well!

I'm building {IDEA_PLAIN}. We map every workflow inside a business in 30 days, identify what can be automated, and guarantee a 5x ROI in year one.

It's the most exciting company I've been part of, and I believe it will surpass Yieldify (acquired by Publicis) and Reachdesk ($225m Series B).

Most of our pull is coming from Growth / PE Value Creation teams wanting a repeatable way to drive AI-led growth across the portfolio.

We have seen that PE firms are struggling to measure AI ROI across their portfolio. Would love your take on how you're approaching it - and what we're building. Would 15-30 mins this week or next work?

Best,
Jay
